question: Can exact query-row chunking remove the observed single-parent quadratic temporary while all twenty sealed parents retain the unchanged native mesh contract?
method: Run the same twenty parents once each in fixed order and fresh E1 processes. Preserve all pinned Cano formulas, reference order, first-tie argmin and strict geometry thresholds; release completed query-row distance chunks using a fixed 32-MiB temporary target. Audit only V1R3 failure state/summary/seal metadata; never read or reuse failed mesh assets.
baseline: V1R3 formal FAIL after 7/20: S04_3d_unicyclic_small_C14 reached 2199797760 bytes in the pinned full A-by-B-by-3 distance matrix under a 2147483648-byte limit.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable V1R4 batch: same twenty sealed parents, exact query-row memory bounding, one fresh E1 child and mesh per parent, independent 2-GiB RSS traces, ten train previews and zero validation previews; zero LiDAR, teacher, formal samples, training, models, C09/C10 or M-TARE; no failed-run reuse.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 批准 after the exact V1R4 scope, cost, evidence and exclusions were displayed.

resource_contract.definition: For each parent, sum batch runner RSS and its one active fresh E1 worker plus descendants.
resource_contract.on_rss_exceed: SIGINT active worker group, mark batch FAIL and seal without retry.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly twenty fixed-order workers launch once each and all bounded-geometry receipts pass.
Exactly twenty unique mesh/sanitation/metric records and ten train-only previews pass.
Every parent remains at or below 2147483648 bytes; batch remains within 7200 seconds and 1073741824 result bytes.
All source, environment, exclusion, zero-downstream and final seal checks pass.
stop_conditions: Any authorization, source, identity, order, split, environment, tool, memory-contract or output drift.
Any worker/resource/mesh/sanitation failure, retry, reselection, failed-run reuse, validation preview or downstream operation.
expected_evidence: Twenty worker logs, RSS traces/summaries, receipts, meshes, sanitation records and metrics.
Ten train maps, exact bounded-geometry provenance, summary, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Twenty sequential fresh CPU workers; zero GPU and downstream execution.
